description: Make a free Indian wedding invite on ForeverVow with the couple's names and functions (haldi, mehendi, sangeet, wedding, reception…). Returns a link that opens the finished draft in the ForeverVow editor, where the couple can change anything, add photos, an RSVP page and a song, then publish one link to share on WhatsApp and download a free MP4 video and PDF. Ask for any missing names, dates, times or venues first; nothing is published until the couple presses Publish.

design.description: Design key from list_designs, e.g. "palace", "raj-haveli". Defaults to "palace".

functions.description: Each function in order. Times are local (India) time.

name: create_invite
title: Create a wedding invite draft
